# Recorded MTA feeds

These are the original first-round protobuf responses from the user's
`~/leet/mta_realtime_investigation/samples/raw` investigation, collected
September 6, 2026 around 00:59 UTC. They are immutable test data, not live service.
All eight operational groups and the subway-alerts feed are included.

Schemas in `server/proto` are the MTA-linked NYCT and Mercury schemas and the
standard GTFS-Realtime schema from that same investigation. Copyright and license
notices are retained in each file. Sources: https://www.mta.info/developers
and https://github.com/OneBusAway/onebusaway-gtfs-realtime-api/tree/master/src/main/proto/com/google/transit/realtime.
